meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 会当主持人,把你选中的 git worktree、分支或 PR 拉进一个共享 markdown 聊天室,让它们分轮对话,最后自己写出一份汇总方案:以哪个为目标、合并顺序、还有哪些冲突待解决。全程只读,它不做提交或合并。
howto.when: 当你想比较多个 worktree、分支或 PR 的改动、并汇总成一份合并方案时进入。若只有 0 或 1 个候选,它会说明这不算 standup,并询问是否放宽范围。

say.text: 帮我看看最近 4 小时活跃的 worktree,开一次 standup
say.note: 它会列出名单让你确认后再开始

say.text: 把这些分支和 PR 都拉进 standup,定出目标分支和合并顺序
say.note: 它会按轮次协调,全程只读

say.text: 用大白话讲 standup 的结论,以及哪些决定要我来做
say.note: 输出方案和只有你能拍板的问题

howto.what_en: Claude facilitates: it brings chosen git worktrees, branches or PRs into one shared markdown room, runs rounds of discussion, then writes one consolidation plan — target, merge order, open decisions. Read-only, no merges.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to compare several worktrees, branches or PRs and get one consolidation plan. With zero or one candidate it says that isn't a standup and offers to widen the range.

say_en.text: Open a standup over worktrees active in the last 4 hours
say_en.note: It lists them so you can confirm the roster.

say_en.text: Bring these branches and PRs into the standup; settle target and merge order
Explain the standup result in plain language, and what decisions are mine
say_en.note: You get the plan plus the calls only you can make.
